channels.label: Position
channels.reason: Body position channel; a flat trace is consistent with an unchanged position.

channels.label: TIB_Sx
channels.reason: Italian 'TIB Sx' means left tibialis leg EMG.

channels.label: TIB_Dx
channels.reason: Italian 'TIB Dx' means right tibialis leg EMG.

channels.label: MIC
channels.reason: Microphone with a sound transducer is the snore channel.

channels.label: C3
channels.reason: Unreferenced C3 with contralateral A2 recorded separately.

channels.label: C4
channels.reason: Unreferenced C4 with contralateral A1 recorded separately.

channels.label: O1
channels.reason: Labelled O1, but the trace looked EMG-like rather than EEG, so it is not mapped.

channels.label: O2
channels.reason: Unreferenced O2 with contralateral A1 recorded separately.

channels.label: A1
channels.reason: Left mastoid reference electrode, used as the reference for right-side EEG.

channels.label: A2
channels.reason: Right mastoid reference electrode (EMG-like trace, so check it), used as the reference for left-side EEG.

channels.label: ROC
channels.reason: Right outer canthus EOG.

channels.label: LOC
channels.reason: Left outer canthus EOG.

channels.label: ECG1
channels.reason: ECG electrode paired with ECG2 as a bipolar lead; the trace shows ECG.

channels.label: ECG2
channels.reason: Second ECG electrode, used as the reference for ECG1.

channels.label: EMG1
channels.reason: Chin EMG electrode paired with EMG2.

channels.label: EMG2
channels.reason: Second chin EMG electrode, used as the reference for EMG1.

channels.label: Fp2
channels.reason: Frontopolar EEG has no canonical target.

channels.label: F4
channels.reason: Unreferenced F4 with contralateral A1 recorded separately.

channels.label: P4
channels.reason: Parietal EEG has no canonical target.

channels.label: FP1
channels.reason: Frontopolar EEG has no canonical target.

channels.label: F3
channels.reason: Unreferenced F3 with contralateral A2 recorded separately.

channels.label: P3
channels.reason: Parietal EEG has no canonical target.

channels.label: TORACE
channels.reason: Italian 'torace' is the thoracic effort belt.

channels.label: ADDDOME
channels.reason: Misspelled Italian 'addome' is the abdominal effort belt.

channels.label: STAT
channels.reason: Flat oximeter status channel, not a physiological signal.

channels.label: HR
channels.reason: Heart rate from the oximeter in BPM.

channels.label: SAO2
channels.reason: Oxygen saturation in percent; the trace looks like SpO2.

channels.label: PLETH
channels.reason: Pulse waveform from the oximeter; the trace looks like a plethysmogram.
